text_block_list.text:
A few days before the Mainichi Hai, Yaeno 
Muteki asks her Trainer which rival she 
should be most wary of in the race. The 
Trainer's answer is Oguri Cap.

Oguri Cap, the Umamusume hailing from 
Kasamatsu. Her immense ability was highly 
acclaimed, and she was already drawing 
massive attention.

The day of the Mainichi Hai. Yaeno Muteki 
feels something is off when she senses no 
sharp, intimidating pressure coming from 
Oguri Cap.

However, without letting herself get 
distracted, she focused her mind on the 
race and got psyched up!
